_comment: The specifier of a two-argument `import()` has to be rewritten like any other: with rolldown's default `[name]-[hash].js` chunk names the file the source wrote never exists in the output, so emitting the call verbatim fails at runtime with ERR_MODULE_NOT_FOUND. Nothing is merged here — no manual group, no facade elimination — so only the finalizer's specifier rewrite can make this resolve.
